dedupe_keys.name: next generation probabilistic liquefaction model building at the regional scale

description: Next Generation Probabilistic Liquefaction Model Building at the Regional Scale is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jonathan Schmidt, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This repository contains data and code to reproduce the modeling and figures from "Next Generation Probabilistic Liquefaction Model Building at the Regional Scale" by Schmidt, Dashti, and Torres-Machi (submitted to and in press at Earthquake Spectra). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 10 top-level files (RMD, R, MD). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-vy7w-m141. Keywords: Seismic soil liquefaction, geotechnical earthquake engineering, probabilistic modeling, spatial statistics, Bayesian statistics. Published 2025-09-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
